body.x: Cambridge Audio, Unveils their new product Azur 651R Home Cinema Receiver at the 2013 International CES, Venetian Towers, Suite #30-121.

If you want your music to sound as great as your movies, the Cambridge Audio Azur 651R Home Cinema Receiver and Azur 751R Upsampling Home Cinema Receiver are perfect for pumping out audiophile stereo and the biggest of big-screen surround sound action.

Even the best premium home cinema receivers never normally manage the same feat with stereo music reproduction as they do with effects and full scale surround sound. But that's not the case here as Cambridge Audio has gone all-out to produce a pair of barnstormers that are equally at home delivering the passion and subtle fidelity of truly inspiring music as they are at making you leap out of your seat to big-screen action.
They also unveils 752BD Blue-ray Universal player, 751R and 351R at CES 2013.
